decisions.reason: The bio-based CO2-negative bitumen is the furthest from the core recycling machinery and still lacks reported market evidence, but its upside is large and its uncertainty unresolved, so the firm keeps this cheap option open for another year rather than abandon it prematurely.
The infectious waste plant is a partnership-backed flagship close to the core WASTX modular platform, so it costs little to maintain and its prospects in medical waste markets are still unfolding.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the decentralized recycling strategy and existing manufacturing capabilities directly, and it doubles as a pretreatment stage for other plants, so keeping it is cheap and its value is likely to be realized.
